pooling: last non-padding token; L2 normalized, matching embedding pipeline
input: Original v5 role-first query, byte-equivalent wrapper of the original narrative
heads: 8 field-specific linear exact-code heads; all admissible parent and child codes
objective: per-query categorical cross entropy; no hierarchical ancestor positives
selection: highest mean validation field Top1; first checkpoint at ties
test_policy: Only after training stops and checkpoint selection frozen; report completed epochs/updates and budget stop honestly; retrospective benchmark
limit_claim: Shared-backbone control; does not isolate every difference in optimizer objective, phase2 mining, update count or language-independent effect. Single seed.
